frozen_inputs.frozen_gp_and_scaler: Reuse exact predecessor FROZEN_TRAINING.json values after hash check; zero new GP or scaler fits
frozen_inputs.warmup: 2020 causal context, no backward fill, gaps reset; natural per-asset warmup retained
frozen_inputs.data_role: PROJECT_SEEN_DEVELOPMENT_HISTORY; inspected in attempt1; no pristine OOS or independent confirmatory inference
frozen_inputs.maturity: available[t+1] strictly less than split_end, equality purged; only train labels used in training
frozen_inputs.mask: At decision t use only completed-bar availability, finite past 63 inputs, valid causal volatility and past CP window; cash for currently ineligible assets, no inferred missing prices
frozen_inputs.missing_next_return: If any eligible decision-time asset lacks the realized next return, mark that block INVALID_MISSING_REALIZED_RETURN; do not set its return/exposure to zero or choose an ex-post eligibility mask
frozen_inputs.decision_mask_not_sample_index: Do not reuse predecessor core.py sample_index L110-L112 to form policy CASH eligibility: it checks future returns[t+1]. Keep training mature-label indexing separate from a new purely decision-time mask.
frozen_inputs.reader: diagnose_training.read_training_close limits returned bars dt+DAY<2023 before deriving features; do not call validation-producing prepare/load_close during training

continuation.resume: Load exact model and complete Adam group/state, then restore Torch RNG and NumPy bit-generator after construction/loading; first selected minibatch is original sequence update1025, never reseed at2001/2/3

loss.known_at_decision: r[t+1] is a train-only outcome for learning and validation scoring, never an inference feature or oracle target
loss.loss: -sqrt(365) * mean(z) / sqrt(mean(z*z)-mean(z)^2+1e-9), pooled over the sampled asset-time endpoint rows
loss.variance: population moment; explicit epsilon=1e-9; stop on nonfinite loss/gradient/parameters
loss.note: This is a paper-aligned policy objective with a crypto calendar constant, not a native leveraged portfolio or a cost/funding objective

continuation.sampling: Same mature training rows, batch128 replacement, paired continuation batches identical per seed

training_only_common_stop.full_train_diagnostic_loss: J(k)=-sqrt365*mean(z_k)/sqrt(population_centered_var(z_k)+1e-9), fixed pooled2526 endpoints, recomputable from all training predictions; diagnostic ratio differs from expected minibatch ratio
training_only_common_stop.rule: After all six reach common k, first k>=1408 where EACH of six has abs(J(k)-J(k-128)), abs(J(k-128)-J(k-256)), abs(J(k-256)-J(k-384)) all <=0.02 stops ALL six together at current k. Otherwise common hard cap2048. No best checkpoint or individual stopping.
training_only_common_stop.threshold_rationale: One prospective diagnostic in the same loss/SR numerical scale as the previously frozen .02 heuristic; not fitted to validation and not a new adoption gate
training_only_common_stop.interpretation: Locally flat train diagnostic only, not gradient stationarity/global optimum/generalization/economic convergence
training_only_common_stop.nonfinite: Immediate INVALID stop for loss/gradients/parameters/moments; preserve last saved lineage, no restart/retry or previous-checkpoint winner
training_only_common_stop.records: Every128 record full loss/SR/mean/variance/epsilon/position variance/saturation; aggregate preclip/actual post-step Adam-update norm stats and pairing/hash/RNG; save immutable per-arm checkpoints outside Git for failure evidence. These diagnostics do not become extra stop gates.

validation_policy.evaluation_after_training: Exactly one final equal-three-seed-position policy evaluation at the common train-only stopping checkpoint; then same frozen gates/1000rep14dayseed9901 bootstrap and saved-policy audit. No interim validation/inference/rank queries or checkpoint/seed selection
frozen_gates: Ensemble portfolio-proxy Sharpe increment positive in at least 2 of 3 fixed blocks
Aggregate portfolio-proxy Sharpe increment positive in at least 2 of 3 paired seeds
Aggregate ensemble portfolio-proxy Sharpe increment positive
Paired moving-block bootstrap 95% lower bound of aggregate ensemble portfolio-proxy Sharpe increment positive
validation_policy.history_role: SEEN_DEVELOPMENT; original validation was already inspected when this continuation proposal was written, so laterPASS is not independent confirmation or unbiased generalization evidence
validation_policy.if_failure: Stop this single continuation; no learning-rate/clip/batch/horizon/window/seed/extra-update rescue

prospective_counts_if_executed.formula_and_ranges_scope: Normal completion at one common stopping step only
prospective_counts_if_executed.failed_partial_execution: If numerical/resource failure occurs mid-round, models may have unequal and fewer than2304 total updates. Record each segment actual/logged optimizer updates separately; sum confirmed counts. Uncheckpointed/unlogged tail is UNKNOWN, not fabricated from the normal-completion formula. Failed runs do not enter validation.
